text:
Eve L.: quick flag — after flipping v2 opt-in for the SDK-beta cohort we saw noisy telemetry: some requests are being attributed to v1 in billing but show v2 in the per-route dashboard. Not great for deprecation metrics.

Sam K.: yup. Root cause seems to be a handshake gap: client header -> routing decision (v1) -> later model-router picks v2 variant. Two different fields written: route_tag and model_variant. ETL aggregates both.

Rohit P.: can we enforce a single "handshake" at ingress which all downstream services read? idea: routing sets header X-Redwood-Handshake = v1|v2|compat and we treat that as canonical attribution for billing/quota.

Nina B.: UX implication: console currently shows an "expected delta" that customers will act on. short-term: hide the billing delta for any cohort where handshake mismatch rate > 2% and show a banner: "Attribution unstable - preview is sampling-only".

Eve L.: agree. also propose: SDKs that don't send X-Client-Version should be treated as "compat" and default-billed to v1 until canonicalization is complete. protects customers.

Sam K.: implementation sketch:
- routing: set X-Redwood-Handshake at decision point before proxy.
- model-router/enrichment: never overwrite X-Redwood-Handshake; can add model_variant but not change attribution.
- ETL: precedence: X-Redwood-Handshake -> route_tag -> model_variant. Missing header => default to v1 for billing.
- console: preview API should return attribution_confidence and sample_trace_ids.

Rohit P.: estimate: routing header + tests ~3-5 hrs, model-router guard ~2 hrs, ETL precedence + small sample backfill ~6 hrs. console preview change ~3 hrs incl copy. total ~1 day cross-team.

console-bot: Incident filed -> INC-2026-981 (duplicate attribution in v2 rollout) https://redwood/incidents/INC-2026-981

Nina B.: PM note: we should also add a deprecation banner in Console for tenants that will be impacted by v1 sunset. Banner should include: "Why you're affected", "Estimated impact (sample)" and a link to opt-out/lock to v1 for 30d. Legal asked for 72h notice for big customers.

Eve L.: owners: Sam (routing + model-router guard), Rohit (ETL precedence + backfill), Nina (console copy + tenant banner), I'll own coordination and verification.

Sam K.: will open PR for the header and a small integration test that verifies header survives enrichment and is present in telemetry topic.

Rohit P.: will add precedence in the next ETL deploy and run a 1% validation backfill; if numbers look ok we'll run a full reprocess. will monitor CPU and token-processing latency.

oncall-bot: scheduling 1% validation backfill window: 02:30-03:00 UTC. paging oncall if CPU > 75% or p99 latency > 200ms.

Nina B.: console patch will add an "Attribution health" pill: green/yellow/red and a link to 5 sample traces when red. UI will default to hide billing delta when red. mock ready by EOD.

Eve L.: one more thought: add telemetry metric handshake_mismatch_rate (per-tenant) so we can gate rollouts automatically. if rate > 1% block rollforward. low friction automated safety.

Sam K.: good call. I'll add metric emission when we detect route_tag != X-Redwood-Handshake in pipeline.

Rohit P.: and ETL will export a reconciliation report: tokens_by_handshake vs tokens_by_model_variant so PMs can verify before tenant comms.

Eve L.: thanks. plan: ship routing header today, ETL tomorrow, console preview + gating by next deploy. Lia will own tenant comms for larger customers once we have reconciliation numbers. :thumbsup:
